# `igdev help`

Usage:
  igdev help            show every command
  igdev help status     show one command with its flags and examples

## Usage

```text
igdev help [command] [flags]
```

## Examples

```text
  igdev help
  igdev help status
  igdev help status --json
```

## Options

```text
  -h, --help   help for help
```

## Global options

```text
      --config stringArray   override one config key for this run, key=value (highest precedence)
      --json                 emit the JSON envelope on stdout (machine mode)
```

## Agent usage

pass --json for the machine contract: the rendered text arrives as
data.help with data.command and data.section, because stdout may then carry nothing but
the envelope. Use it to read one command's complete reference without a terminal; an
unknown topic is IGDEV_E_USAGE at exit 2, with Remediation pointing at igdev help.
